summary: Ethan comes back for Mom's 김밥 (Dad claims he made it; Mom: 'just the rice'). Mom slips into 반말 and he asks her to talk casually. She explains 축의금: cash in an envelope instead of a present, even for Michael's wedding; family gives more than friends; the name matters most. 준수 says he'll give the least. Ethan writes his name in Korean and Mom shows it off.

paragraphs.ko: 다음 토요일, 이선은 김밥을 먹으러 다시 서윤이 부모님 집에 갔다.
paragraphs.en: The next Saturday, Ethan went back to Seoyun's parents' house to eat kimbap.

paragraphs.ko: 어머니: "이선 씨, 왔어? 아, 왔어요?" 이선이 웃었다. "저한테는 그냥 말 편하게 하세요." 어머니: "그래? 나도 그게 편해. 여기 앉아."
paragraphs.en: Mother: "Ethan, you came? Oh, I mean, you came?" Ethan laughed. "Please just talk to me casually." Mother: "Yeah? That's easier for me too. Sit here."

paragraphs.ko: 식탁 위에 김밥이 정말 많았다. 아버지가 웃으면서 말했다. "이선 씨, 이 김밥은 내가 만들었어요." 어머니: "당신은 밥만 했잖아."
paragraphs.en: There was a huge pile of kimbap on the table. Father smiled and said, "Ethan, I made this kimbap." Mother: "All you did was make the rice."

paragraphs.ko: 김밥 옆에는 봉투가 몇 개 있었다. 이선: "이건 뭐예요?" 어머니: "축의금이야. 결혼식에 갈 때 여기에 돈을 넣어서 줘."
paragraphs.en: Next to the kimbap were a few envelopes. Ethan: "What are these?" Mother: "Wedding gift money. When you go to a wedding, you put money in here and give it."

paragraphs.ko: 이선: "이번에도 줘야 돼요? 마이클 씨는 한국 사람 아니잖아요." 어머니: "줘, 줘. 우리는 선물보다 돈을 더 많이 줘. 받는 사람도 그게 좋고."
paragraphs.en: Ethan: "Do you have to, even this time? Michael isn't Korean." Mother: "We do, we do. We give money a lot more than presents. The people getting it like that, too."

paragraphs.ko: 이선: "얼마나 넣어요?" 어머니: "친구는 보통 조금 넣고, 가족은 그것보다 많이 넣어."
paragraphs.en: Ethan: "How much do you put in?" Mother: "Friends usually put in a little, and family puts in more than that."

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: "이선 씨, 돈은 중요하지 않아요. 이름을 꼭 써야 돼요." 서윤: "이름이 가장 중요해. 이름이 없으면 누가 줬는지 몰라."
paragraphs.en: Father: "Ethan, the money isn't important. You have to write your name." Seoyun: "The name is the most important part. Without a name, nobody knows who gave it."

paragraphs.ko: 그때 준수가 방에서 나왔다. 어머니: "준수야, 너 지금 일어났어? 지금 오후야." 준수: "형, 내가 가장 조금 넣을 거야. 나는 학생이잖아." 이선: "준수야, 나도 돈 많이 없어."
paragraphs.en: Just then Junsu came out of his room. Mother: "Junsu, did you just get up? It's the afternoon." Junsu: "Hyung, I'll be putting in the least. I'm a student, you know." Ethan: "Junsu, I don't have much money either."

paragraphs.ko: 어머니: "이선 씨는 서윤이랑 같이 하나만 해. 준수 너는 김밥이나 먹어. 이선 씨도 더 먹어. 오늘 많이 만들었어." 아버지: "내가 만들었어요." 어머니: "밥만!"
paragraphs.en: Mother: "Ethan, you and Seoyun just do one together. Junsu, you eat your kimbap. Ethan, you eat more too. I made a lot today." Father: "I made it." Mother: "Just the rice!"

paragraphs.ko: 준수가 크게 웃었다. 이선은 봉투를 하나 받아서 한국어로 이름을 썼다. 어머니가 그걸 보고 웃었다. "서윤아, 이선 씨 이름 좀 봐!"
paragraphs.en: Junsu burst out laughing. Ethan took an envelope and wrote his name in Korean. Mother saw it and smiled. "Seoyun, look at Ethan's name!"

questions.prompt_ko: 아버지는 김밥을 만들 때 뭘 했어요?
questions.prompt_en: What did Father do when the kimbap was made?
What did Father say was important?

questions.prompt_en: "We give money more ___ presents." What goes in the blank?
